//: Not a workspace member — a module-type marker, and nothing else.
sdk/package.json deliberately declares no `type` (a subpackage omitting its own would inherit it, and
hardhat/v2 is commonjs), so under `nodenext` a bare `.ts` here would resolve as CommonJS and every
`import` would be an error. This one line makes scripts/ an ESM directory, for node and tsc alike.
`private` so nothing can ever publish it.
